title: Hand laceration: tendons and nerves
stem: Cubicle 18. Ms Lam, 23, a left-handed chef, cut the palm side of her right ring finger with a sashimi knife 2 hours ago. The bleeding has stopped; the finger feels numb and weak. Take a brief history, examine her hand, and counsel her.

phases.title: Examine
phases.goal: Each tendon and nerve, and the circulation.

phases.title: Counsel
phases.goal: Why surgery, and what happens to her work.

notes:
Checked against BSSH (British Society for Surgery of the Hand) standards for hand trauma (2021), BOAST 'Hand trauma' guidance, and standard examination.

Flexor digitorum profundus (FDP): flexion of the DIP joint with the PIP held straight. Flexor digitorum superficialis (FDS): flexion of the PIP joint while the other fingers are held in extension (blocks FDP). Digital nerves: two-point discrimination (normal under 6 mm at the fingertip) and light touch on each side of the finger; vascular: capillary refill and colour of the pulp. Look at the resting cascade: a finger lying straight out of line suggests a flexor tendon cut. Also check the median, ulnar and radial nerves in the hand ('123' in your notes).

Any suspected flexor tendon or digital nerve injury needs referral to hand surgery for exploration and repair (ideally within days; BSSH), with the wound irrigated, dressed and the hand splinted in the meantime; antibiotics are not routine for clean wounds; tetanus as indicated. Do not explore flexor tendon wounds in the ED.

Your notes (PP 2024 case) match this.

Perfect script checked against BSSH flexor tendon guidance, an HKCEM-style scheme and a keyword scheme. Removed the 'just stitch it' and false-reassurance replies; added wound care and tetanus.

steps.label: Brief history
steps.hint: Mechanism, time, handedness, occupation, symptoms, tetanus, PMH.

Injury.r: Slicing salmon 2 hours ago; the knife slipped into my ring finger.

Injury.rz: 近尾指嗰邊麻咗。手指尾屈唔到。
Injury.r: The side next to the little finger is numb. I can't bend the tip.

Background.t: Which hand do you write with? Your job?
Background.tz: 你用邊隻手寫字？做咩工作？
有冇打過破傷風針？有冇藥物敏感？

Background.r: Childhood vaccines in Hong Kong. No allergies.

steps.label: Examine
steps.hint: Resting cascade, wound, FDP and FDS separately, digital nerves, circulation, other nerves.

Look.t: Look at the resting cascade of the fingers
Look.r: The ring finger lies straighter than the others.
A 1.5 cm transverse laceration over the volar middle phalanx (zone 2), ulnar side.

Tendons.t: FDP: I hold the middle joint straight; bend the fingertip
Tendons.r: Cannot flex the DIP joint. "FDP divided."

Tendons.t: FDS: I hold the other fingers straight; bend this finger

Nerves.t: Two-point discrimination on each side of the pulp
Nerves.r: Radial side 4 mm. Ulnar side 12 mm and reduced light touch. "Ulnar digital nerve injury."
Nerves.mark: Tests digital nerves with two-point discrimination

Nerves.t: Median, ulnar and radial nerve function in the hand
Nerves.do: say thumbs-up & say opposition & say cross-fingers
Nerves.mark: Tests the median, ulnar and radial nerves

Circulation.t: Capillary refill and colour of the pulp

steps.label: Counsel
steps.hint: Explain tendon and nerve injury, hand surgery referral, splint, dressing, tetanus, work.

turns.line: Can you just stitch it so I can go back to work?
turns.lz: 你幫我縫埋佢就得啦，我要返工。

opts.t: The cut has gone through the deep tendon that bends your fingertip and one of the finger's nerves. These need repairing by the hand surgeons, usually within a few days, to get the best function. Today we'll clean it, dress it and put on a splint.
opts.tz: 個傷口割斷咗屈手指尾嗰條深層筋腱，同埋一條手指神經。呢啲要手外科醫生做手術駁返，通常喺幾日內做，功能先會最好。今日我哋會幫你洗傷口、包紮，同埋上夾板。
opts.rz: 做手術？但我係靠對手搵食㗎……
opts.r: An operation? But I work with my hands…
opts.mark: Explains tendon and nerve injury and the need for surgical repair

turns.line: An operation? But I work with my hands…
turns.lz: 做手術？但我係靠對手搵食㗎……

opts.t: That's exactly why repair matters. Afterwards you'll need hand therapy for a few months, and you'll be off work for a while — we'll give you a certificate. Keep the splint on and the dressing dry; come back if it becomes red, hot or swollen.
opts.tz: 正正因為咁，先要駁返好佢。手術後要做幾個月手部物理治療，都要休息一排唔返得工——我哋會開病假紙俾你。夾板要戴住，敷料保持乾爽；如果變紅、發熱或者腫，就要返嚟。
opts.mark: Explains rehabilitation, time off work and safety-netting

opts.t: Today: we irrigate the wound, close the skin loosely or dress it, put on a splint, and refer you to the hand surgeons. Your tetanus is up to date from childhood, but you'll get a booster as it's been over 10 years.
opts.tz: 今日我哋會沖洗傷口，鬆鬆咁縫埋或者包紮，上夾板，再轉介手外科。你細個打齊破傷風針，但已經超過十年，所以會幫你打一針加強針。

qs.q: How do you test FDS in isolation?
qs.a: Hold the other fingers straight; flex the PIP
wrong: Hold the PIP straight and flex the DIP
Resisted wrist flexion with the fingers straight
Ask her to make a tight fist

qs.a: Hold the PIP straight; flex the DIP
wrong: Hold the other fingers straight; flex the PIP
Oppose the thumb to the little finger

qs.q: Normal static two-point discrimination at the fingertip?

qs.a: Distal palmar crease to FDS insertion ('no man's land')
wrong: At the wrist, proximal to the carpal tunnel
At the fingertip, distal to the FDS insertion
In the forearm, at the musculotendinous junction

qs.q: Should flexor tendons be repaired in the ED?
wrong: Only in zone 2, where tendons adhere

badge.name: Tendon Tracker

cards.why: Especially on the border digits' contact sides.

cards.q: Median nerve motor test in the hand?
cards.why: Ulnar: finger abduction; radial: wrist/finger extension.

cards.q: Antibiotics for a clean hand laceration?
options: Only if a tendon is cut
